candidate.name: Predictive Intelligence Sharpening of Onsets
candidate.base: unchanged MCL Two-Speed Auction Relay V18
candidate.objective: Distinguish acceptance, exhaustion, absorption, and fakeout at the earliest causal clock without changing V18 direction or forcing faster action.

causal_alignment.treatment: every exact V18 RAW_TURN, including vetoed and later non-admitted turns
causal_alignment.bar_clock: only exact matched-contract completed CL/MCL bars at or before the raw-turn close
causal_alignment.event_clock: pre-turn [-60s,0), response [0s,60s), maturation [60s,300s); no fabricated quiet seconds
causal_alignment.weekly_clock: five finalized Globex sessions ending strictly before the treatment session
causal_alignment.news_clock: latest publication at or before treatment; stale when age exceeds its own declared horizon
causal_alignment.direction: raw V18 direction signs morphology; routed direction is attribution only and never rewritten
causal_alignment.roll: no feature spans a contract change; a successor event generation is required at roll

exact_bar_primitives.tr_velocity_h: mean(last h TR) - mean(previous h TR)
exact_bar_primitives.basis_slope_velocity_6: six-bar basis slope velocity using only completed matched bars

exact_event_primitives.microprice_slope_velocity: direction-signed late-half minus early-half slope over active one-second microprice closes using actual elapsed seconds
exact_event_primitives.microprice_tr_velocity: late-half minus early-half mean microprice high-low range in ticks
exact_event_primitives.quote_intensity_acceleration: late-half minus early-half quote events per active second
exact_event_primitives.spread_elasticity: last-minus-first spread plus maximum spread in ticks
exact_event_primitives.top_size_pressure: direction-signed same-price bid/ask size add/remove proxy from the existing tape
exact_event_primitives.book_handoff: CL, MCL, simultaneous, or absent first-mid-move leadership plus MCL-minus-CL receipt microseconds
exact_event_primitives.basis_reconvergence: direction-signed response-window change followed by maturation-window reversal toward the pre-turn basis
exact_event_primitives.limitations: L1 proxies never claim depth, queue, identified cancellation/refill, market-maker intent, or colocated latency

one_second_to_four_hour_temporal_torsion.fast: pre-to-response and response-to-maturation CL/MCL microprice slope/TR acceleration
one_second_to_four_hour_temporal_torsion.slow: direction-signed 48-bar slope velocity/acceleration and 48-bar TR velocity/acceleration
one_second_to_four_hour_temporal_torsion.shape: the exact fast-slope, slow-slope, fast-TR, slow-TR sign tuple
one_second_to_four_hour_temporal_torsion.hypothesis: authentic onset is a causal transfer of energy across clocks; fakeout or exhaustion is fast displacement opposed by decelerating or absorbing four-hour structure

five_minute_to_four_hour_volatility_phas.fast: current-versus-prior completed five-minute TR velocity and direction-signed path efficiency
five_minute_to_four_hour_volatility_phas.slow: 48-bar TR velocity/acceleration and direction-signed slope acceleration
five_minute_to_four_hour_volatility_phas.shape: joint expansion, local ignition from slow compression, local exhaustion inside slow expansion, or joint compression
five_minute_to_four_hour_volatility_phas.hypothesis: local range ignition is useful only when its slow financing state distinguishes new information from late turbulence

one_second_to_fifteen_minute_to_one_week.fast: CL-to-MCL handoff, direction-signed microprice acceleration, and persistence across response/maturation
one_second_to_fifteen_minute_to_one_week.meso: three-bar slope velocity and acceleration from completed five-minute bars
one_second_to_fifteen_minute_to_one_week.slow: strictly prior five-session return, return velocity, TR velocity, and state age
one_second_to_fifteen_minute_to_one_week.shape: the exact fast, meso, and weekly sign/state tuple
one_second_to_fifteen_minute_to_one_week.hypothesis: the best onset may be a fast discovery event inside a meso transition that is financed by, or cleanly reverses, the weekly prior

one_second_dual_book_to_thirty_minute_ba.fast: CL/MCL lead, acceptance/absorption, and basis divergence or reconvergence
one_second_dual_book_to_thirty_minute_ba.meso: six-bar matched basis slope velocity and acceleration
one_second_dual_book_to_thirty_minute_ba.slow: causal fresh news pressure, delta, velocity, impact, confidence, and declared horizon
one_second_dual_book_to_thirty_minute_ba.shape: book-handoff, basis-curvature, and fresh-news sign tuple
one_second_dual_book_to_thirty_minute_ba.hypothesis: news crowding becomes useful when dominant-book discovery and transport-basis behavior reveal acceptance or rejection; news never owns direction

liquidity_elasticity_cascade.fast: direction-signed microprice displacement per quote update, spread expansion/contraction, top-size pressure, and signed prints
liquidity_elasticity_cascade.meso: current five-minute direction-signed path efficiency and TR transition
liquidity_elasticity_cascade.slow: four-hour direction-signed slope acceleration plus V18 trend-state age
liquidity_elasticity_cascade.shape: tight-book displacement, wide-book air pocket, absorbed pressure, or silent acceptance, crossed with meso efficiency and slow age
liquidity_elasticity_cascade.hypothesis: a real turn should transmit price through available liquidity; a fake may require spread inflation or pressure without durable transport acceptance

count_first_law.historical_bar_census: expose only readiness and categorical occurrence counts over exact V18 turns; no return, MFE, MAE, PnL, trade outcome, or winner

historical_testability_gate.exact_v18_signal_identity: 1493 raw turns and 338 admissions over the frozen complete available tape
historical_testability_gate.breadth: each family must retain both raw directions, both admitted routes, GTH and RTH attribution, and both periods; no shape is selected as a winner

prospective_event_gate.prefix_identity: zero invalid, late, hash-failed, or generation-drifted rows

count_first_law.family_testability: a family must have both raw directions, continuation and failed-auction admissions, GTH and RTH, both available periods, and no category selected from outcome
count_first_law.adjacency: at most one semantic adjacent formulation per family, frozen before outcomes; no numeric grid

future_outcome_boundary.after_gate: freeze matched no-turn controls, categorical action law, and settlement in a successor preregistration before exposing outcomes
future_outcome_boundary.required_comparison: unchanged V18 versus each frozen action under primary and stressed costs across periods, directions, routes, lanes, hostile regimes, concentration, and drawdown
future_outcome_boundary.crown: the missing first challenge year plus runtime, transport, capital, restart, and authentic profitability proofs remain mandatory

prohibitions: no mutation or duplication of V18 direction, routing, maturation, risk reduction, costs, or lifecycle
no unfinished slow bar, interpolation, fabricated quiet second, or cross-roll feature
no outcome-selected feature, threshold, family, category union, or action
no static multitimeframe consensus or slow-direction takeover
no claim that initial adversity alone identifies a fake turn
no news direction, fixed news coefficient, order, preview, sizing, capital, selection, or live authority
